notes: Add Stop on the Route searches your customers. Tap one to add them to the day you are viewing, or tap New Customer to create one and add them to the route.
The customer card has a Route tile again, and each address has Add to Route, so winterize-only addresses can be added too. Notify is now a link beside Edit.
Optimize can Start From My Location. It checks your location once when you tap Optimize, so stop 1 is the stop closest to you.
